remarks: Nestled within the quiet, well-maintained Riverbend Common community, this stylish 1-bedroom + loft, 2-bath townhome offers a rare combination of character, natural light, and convenience in the heart of Norwalk. Thoughtfully designed for comfortable everyday living, the home features soaring vaulted ceilings, peaceful garden views, and inviting indoor/outdoor spaces that create an airy, relaxed feel throughout. The main level is anchored by a dramatic living room with a wood-burning fireplace and direct access to a private balcony overlooking beautifully landscaped grounds- perfect for morning coffee or work-from-home days. The updated galley kitchen features sleek granite countertops, designer tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances and adjacent powder room. Off the living room, a spiral staircase leads to a spectacular loft with two skylights - ideal for a home office, den, or guest space. The spacious primary suite offers oversized closets, soaring ceilings, a well-appointed bath, and access to a second private balcony. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry and low-maintenance living within a pet-friendly community. Minutes to Tavern at GrayBarns, SONO, Metro North, I-95, Cranbury Park, Calf Pasture Beach, wellness studios, retail, The SoNo Collection, Whole Foods, Stew Leonard's, and the Stamford + Westport line. Ultra-commutable in every direction. Low HOA. Incredible value. Turn-key. Move right in and enjoy!
